Base M: close precedents exist for every piece (ITSM toolkit shape, EmailToolConfig dual auth, MS_TEAMS migration 8b2c1a4d5e6f with delete-before-shrink downgrade, WEB_SEARCH/SCHEDULERS SettingDeclaration). Bumped +1 because the AC enumerates forward-migration and rollback cases and no Alembic up/down test harness exists.
